output.objection: I did not agree to skip the quality gates, I am asking for the time to run them by hand so we do not ship a broken forecast. You cannot treat my caution as a lack of ambition.
output.correction: You are reading my request for manual checks as a rejection of automation, which is not what I said. I am simply refusing to let a model go live until I have verified the metrics myself.
